rules.name: place_disc
conditions: any d in directions: flanks(target, d, current_player)
effects: for d in directions[flanks(target, d, current_player)]: flip_line(target, d, current_player)

end_conditions.condition: has_legal_move(player1) == false and has_legal_move(player2) == false and count(pieces[owner == player1]) == count(pieces[owner == player2])

_comments.flanks: flanks(space, direction, player) returns true if placing at space and looking in direction, there is one or more opponent pieces followed by a piece owned by player. This is the core legality check for Reversi.
_comments.flip_line: flip_line(space, direction, player) walks from space in direction, changing ownership of each opponent piece until reaching a piece owned by player. Only pieces that were flanked by the original placement flip — newly flipped pieces do NOT trigger further flips.
_comments.has_legal_move: has_legal_move(player) returns true if the player has at least one space where placing would flank opponent pieces in any direction. Used for the pass/turn-skip mechanic.
_comments.directions: All 8 directions on a rect8 grid: N, NE, E, SE, S, SW, W, NW.
